subject: Genomics Labs - Data transfer safeguards & DPA queries
messages:
From: Michael Frost <michael.frost@genomicslabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@genomicslabs.com>
Date: 2025-06-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: Data transfer safeguards + DPA annex questions

Kim,

Thanks for taking this RFP stream with us. As part of Genomics Labs' vendor due diligence we need a compact set of answers and evidence focused on cross-border transfers and the DPA annex. Key items we need by EOD 2025-06-17: 

1) Mapping of data flows (EU->US or other regions) and any routing fallbacks
2) Confirmation of lawful basis & subprocessors list with EU-only options
3) Technical measures for pseudonymization/encryption at rest and in transit
4) DPF-specific evidence for operational controls (logs, retention, auditability)
5) KMS/HSM details and proof of key separation where applicable

A few specifics: we use AWS eu-west-1 primarily and need to ensure token-level logs and any inference artifacts can be retained and processed within the EU for regulated pipelines. Also please call out any features that might route models or KV caches outside the EU by default.

If you need a template, I've attached our vendor questionnaire (not included in this export). If you can share an initial package (even redacted) it will help our legal team start the annex redline.

Regards,
Michael Frost
Head of IS Governance
Genomics Labs Inc

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Frost <michael.frost@genomicslabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-11T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Data transfer safeguards + DPA annex questions

Michael —

Thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Attached is an initial evidence pack and a working DPA annex mapping workbook. Highlights up front: 

- Data flow mapping: Redwood defaults to regional routing; for EU customers we can (1) enforce EU-only model routing and KV cache residency on hosted plans (eu-only routing policy), or (2) offer Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) so all inference traffic and logs stay within customer-controlled networks. See network-dataflow-diagram.png.

- Logging & retention: Token-level request/response logs are configurable per-customer. For EU-regulated pipelines we can set token logs retention to EU-only storage with retention windows you define (we've implemented 30/90/365d presets).

- Key management: We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via KMS integrations and HSM-backed key wrapping. Keys can be scoped per-region; evidence in the pack shows KMS config snapshots.

- Pseudonymization & encryption: All data in transit is TLS1.3; at-rest storage uses AES-256. We apply deterministic pseudonymization at ingestion when requested (examples in the pack) and maintain separation between identification metadata and model artifacts.

- Subprocessors & SCC/DPF: The attached dpa-annex-mapping.xlsx lists subprocessors and whether they're EU-resident. We indicate where SCCs or equivalent safeguards apply and have a DPF evidence checklist included.

I've attached: redwood-dpf-evidence-pack.pdf, dpa-annex-mapping.xlsx, network-dataflow-diagram.png. Please confirm which items your legal team wants redlined. If helpful, we can also provide an EU-only technical runbook for Private deployments.

Next steps: If you confirm you want EU-only routing, we'll prepare an addendum that pins routing + KV cache residency and include the DocuSign packet for the DPA annex.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-12T10:00:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: Data transfer safeguards + DPA annex questions

Kim / Karthik — quick internal note before we send the runbook update to Genomics: 

- Add a short paragraph calling out the default behavior of the KV cache (it may replicate across AZs in region; explicitly note it does not replicate cross-region unless configured).
- Confirm cloud provider subprocessors: we'll mark AWS eu-west-1 as primary and list backup clouds (GCP europe-west1) as optional, but clearly flag that EU-only routing disables fallback to non-EU regions.
- Include sample retention config snippet for token-level logs (JSON snippet).

I can draft the runbook page for EU Private deployment (eu-private-deploy-runbook.pdf). Karthik — any legal phrasing you want in the DPA mapping to make redlines faster?

- Marissa
From: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@genomicslabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Frost <michael.frost@genomicslabs.com>, Legal Team <legal@genomicslabs.com>
Date: 2025-06-15T08:30:00Z
Subject: Follow up: KV cache residency + DocuSign for DPA annex

Kimberly — thanks for the packet. A couple clarifications from our side before we proceed with redlines: 

1) KV cache: You mentioned residency controls. Can you confirm whether the cache key-value pairs ever leave the EU in any automatic fallback scenario (e.g., if a model version is only available in another region)? We need an explicit statement that no automated cross-border cache replication occurs unless we sign up for a cross-region SLA.

2) Token logs: Can you provide an example retention policy that shows logs stored in EU-only S3 with server-side encryption using our BYOK?

3) Evidence for operational audits: can you share the most recent internal control attestation (redacted) or a SOC2 summary that maps to DPF controls?

If that all checks out, please send the DPA annex packet via DocuSign and we'll route to Legal for redlines. We prefer the annex to include a clause that requires 30 days' notice prior to any subprocessor addition that entails cross-border transfer.

Link to our preferred DocuSign in case you want to pre-fill: https://docusign.com/packets/GL-2025-089/dpa-annex

Thanks,
Aditi Rao
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Genomics Labs Inc
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@genomicslabs.com>, Michael Frost <michael.frost@genomicslabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-17T16:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow up: KV cache residency + DocuSign for DPA annex

Aditi / Michael —

Thanks — answers below and next steps included. 

1) KV cache residency: Redwood will not automatically replicate KV caches cross-border. KV cache replication only occurs when a customer explicitly opts into cross-region replication or when using a cross-region high-availability SLA. For EU-only customers we can enforce a routing policy at the account level that prevents model or cache traffic from leaving eu-west regions. This is a configurable account-level setting; I'll include a line in the DPA annex mapping that pins routing to eu-west-1/eu-west-2.

2) Token logs & BYOK KMS: We can provision a customer-scoped S3 bucket in eu-west-1 with SSE-KMS using your BYOK. Attached is a sample retention config (included in redwood-dpf-evidence-pack.pdf) and a KMS key policy example.

3) Audit evidence: We have a SOC2 Type II summary that maps to DPF control categories (operational controls, incident response, access control). I've included a redacted control matrix in redwood-dpf-evidence-pack.pdf. For high-assurance customers we also offer an on-site or virtual audit review under NDA.

Clause request: we are comfortable adding a 30-day notice clause for subprocessors that would introduce cross-border transfer. We'll add that language to the DPA annex draft.

DocuSign: I've pre-filled the annex with the EU routing pin and the 30-day subprocessor notice clause and uploaded to your link: https://docusign.com/packets/GL-2025-089/dpa-annex

Attachments included in this message: redwood-dpf-evidence-pack.pdf, dpa-annex-mapping.xlsx, eu-private-deploy-runbook.pdf, network-dataflow-diagram.png.

Please confirm receipt and whether you'd like a call to walk Legal through the technical pieces (we can schedule a 30-minute session with our infra lead).

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
